silhouette.reason: Swept hair, full beard and the profile nose read as a bearded man from FRONT and SIDE; the shoulders are two inflated red balloons that dominate the outline.
fixes: shape the mantle shoulders with a seam and a fold instead of round ellipsoids
lift the front lock at the crown for a stronger hair silhouette

proportions.reason: Face, beard and ears sit well; the shoulder masses are very wide and bulbous for the head (deltoid width ≈ 3.3 head widths) and the beard top edge is a hard horizontal line.
fixes: narrow and flatten the shoulder masses ~15 %
soften the beard top edge into the cheek over > 1.5 cm

materials.reason: Skin, hair, red mantle, purple tunic and brass studs separate by hue; mantle and tunic share skin-like roughness; brass studs read.
fixes: wool strip on the mantle and linen on the tunic with their own roughness
brass finish (metal, low roughness) on the brooch

detail.reason: Lids, beard and hair locks, studs and a brooch hold up at third person; the mantle is a smooth balloon without folds or hem.
fixes: fold lines and a hemmed edge on the mantle
nasolabial and lid folds at LOD0

wear.reason: Clean garments; nothing says where he has been.
fixes: grime at the mantle hem and collar
a scar or sun weathering on the face

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps outline, beard and the colour blocks; the face flattens and the tunic colours break into blocks.
fixes: keep the brow/nose mass at LOD2

technical.reason: QA clean; 101k / 28k / 3.6k tris for a bust, a third of it on featureless mantle shoulders.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 60k: decimate the mantle shoulders at source (fewer rings)
eye socket joints at LOD1 need a coarser bore
